specs.Features: Low Profile Fusion Plate and Screw , Detachable/ Modular Head , Medial Cortical Screw

description: The CREO LINX is a single level modular pedicle screw post connector for use with the CREO AMP system. It is an implant that locks to the modular post that replaces the rod and caps used in traditional fixation methods. The system translates to accomodate several mm of translation.
